headline: Ecuador economic activity expands 4.4% in September on services and farming
summary: Ecuador's economic activity grew 4.4% year-on-year in September 2026, led by agriculture, services, and manufacturing, offsetting contractions in petroleum and mining.
why: Ecuador is an emerging South American economy reliant on oil exports and agricultural commodities; broader non-oil activity provides insight into domestic demand.

impacts.name: Ecuador
impacts.why: Economic activity grew 4.4% year-on-year, driven by gains across five of six major sectors.
